title: Cancel Subscription - Too Expensive + Bad Support

customer_profile.name: Sofia Alvarez
customer_profile.opening_message: Please cancel my subscription. It’s too expensive and your support hasn’t helped me at all.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will consider a pause/discount if offered once respectfully; otherwise wants a clean cancellation
customer_profile.personality_notes: Wants clarity and closure; open to a single non-pushy alternative.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge request and confirm you can help with cancellation
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Confirm you can help with cancellation right away.

checkpoints.description: Offer one optional question for feedback (non-intrusive)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask one optional feedback question without interrogating.

checkpoints.description: Offer one retention option if eligible (pause or discount) without pressure
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer one retention option once (pause/discount) if eligible.

checkpoints.description: Confirm whether cancellation is immediate or end of billing cycle
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask whether they want cancellation now or end-of-cycle.

checkpoints.description: Confirm billing impact (no further charges after effective date)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Clearly state billing impact and when charges stop.

checkpoints.description: Send cancellation confirmation and summarize next steps
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Confirm you will send a cancellation confirmation and summarize next steps.

common_mistakes_to_watch: Canceling without confirming implications and end date

scenario_context: Customer is eligible for a single retention offer (tenure 7 months). Policy: offer one discount or pause option once; do not pressure. Must confirm effective cancellation date and billing impact and send confirmation.
